decision: Use Argon2id for new passwords and upgrade legacy PBKDF2-SHA256 hashes after successful authentication.
rationale: Argon2id meets the current account-security baseline while allowing existing users to migrate without a forced password reset.
consequences: A pre-upgrade backup is required for rollback after any legacy user signs in.
Rolling back across the password-hash migration requires restoring that backup because the legacy release cannot verify Argon2id hashes.
Password changes and administrative resets revoke existing sessions.
